blind.description: A low, roughly circular heap consisting of light-tan wood shavings, curled ribbons, and small cut wooden blocks/cubes. The individual curls and blocks are clustered tightly into a single decorative pile with natural hollows and intertwined flakes. The underside sits flat against the ground plane without any separate artificial base plate.
blind.from_above: A circular mound of textured, curled tan flakes and small blocky chunks, resembling a scattered cluster of cereal, curls of wood, or a rough round biscuit.
defects: tangled, fused geometry where thin curled shaving strips intersect
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 6 inches tall (roughly 1/12th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet in diameter.
